channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Empresários e banqueiros pedem estabilidade a Lula e se queixam de juros altos
item.description: Business leaders and bankers invited to dinner at the Alvorada Palace requested economic and institutional stability from President Lula, expressing concern about high interest rates. The meeting took place Monday night in Brasília. Guests emphasized the importance of policies ensuring legal certainty for the business sector.

item.title: "Somos mais conservadores": Felipe Nunes, fundador do Quaest, analisa avanço da direita no Brasil
item.description: Felipe Nunes, founder of the Quaest institute, states that Brazilian society has become more conservative and right-wing, with self-declared right-wing identification rising from 20% in 2002 to about 35% today. He attributes this shift to increased political awareness and ideological alignment among citizens, reducing the number of people who claim no political definition. He also introduces his book 'Brasil no Espelho', which analyzes the current profile of Brazilians.

item.title: Bolsonaristas avisam governo Trump sobre mensagens entre Vorcaro e Moraes
item.description: Leaked PF messages reveal contacts between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro, including meetings at the minister's apartment and an alleged attempt to help Vorcaro flee the country before his arrest. Bolsonaro allies shared the material with Trump administration figures to push for renewed Magnitsky Act sanctions against Moraes. Flávio Bolsonaro leads a move to create a congressional inquiry into the minister's ties to Vorcaro.

item.title: Copa do Brasil: Palmeiras eliminou Santos em todos os duelos da competição
item.description: Palmeiras faces Santos in the Copa do Brasil second leg, defending a 3-0 first-leg advantage. All previous meetings between the teams in the competition ended with Palmeiras advancing.

item.title: Lula avalia medida anti-bets para antes das eleições; veja detalhes
item.description: President Lula is considering implementing measures against online betting before the October elections, targeting platforms such as Jogo do Tigrinho. The initiative, still under evaluation, could include advertising restrictions or stricter actions using provisional measures or judicial initiatives.

item.title: Funks clássicos viram aposta de candidatos na corrida presidencial de 2026
item.description: In the 2026 presidential race, candidates use 1990s funk classics to engage voters. 'Rap da Felicidade' is adopted by Augusto Cury (Avante), while 'Rap do Silva' supports Lula's (PT) re-election. This strategy aims to connect with voters from peripheries and large urban centers.

item.title: As mensagens de Vorcaro a Moraes e o futuro do Caso Master no Supremo - O Assunto #1796
item.description: Justice André Mendonça released a sealed Federal Police report suggesting messaging between Daniel Vorcaro and Alexandre de Moraes prior to the Banco Master arrest, hinting at potential protection. The report also claims Moraes may have edited a contract between his wife's law firm and Vorcaro, and that a $1.6 million payment to the film Dark Horse followed public pressure from Flávio Bolsonaro. Mendonça requested clarification from the Attorney General's office and proposed the case return to the STF plenary.

item.title: Con las manos manchadas de catástrofe
item.description: In 2026, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva highlighted new oil and gas discoveries in Brazil, comparing them to those of 2007, during his re-election campaign. The strategy contrasts with global climate challenges, as rivals advocate for increased fossil fuel exploitation.

item.title: Renan cometeu erro, mas punição aplicada por Toffoli era exagerada
item.description: Online electoral campaigns require new regulation to prevent manipulation, such as prohibiting political profiles in recommendation systems during the electoral period. The TSE requires all virtual profiles to be declared in the candidate registration process to ensure balanced exposure of candidates.

item.title: Líderes nas pesquisas precisam, às pressas, aprender a ouvir eleitores de Cury
item.description: During the Band debate on August 23, doctor and writer Augusto Cury surprised by leading internet searches, scoring 8% in BTG/Nexus and 7.8% in AtlasIntel, positioning himself as a leading figure in the third way. Amid electoral volatility, his rapid social media growth—from 8.3 million to 10.5 million followers—demonstrates significant impact. Lula leads with 37% and Flávio Bolsonaro follows with 30% in the same poll.

item.title: Precisamos debater maioridade penal com os dados certos
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies Special Committee is analyzing a proposal to reduce the age of criminal responsibility, debating 15 related requests amid political polarization on security issues. The topic is central to public policy discussions, but evidence-based analysis is hindered by polarization.

item.title: Quaest divulga nesta quarta (2) nova pesquisa da eleição presidencial
item.description: Quaest released a new presidential poll with voting intentions for the first round, featuring 13 candidates including Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Pablo Marçal. The survey, commissioned by Globo and O Globo, interviewed 2,004 people between August 30 and September 1, with a margin of error of ±2 percentage points and 95% confidence. It also simulates five second-round scenarios, including a new one between Lula and Augusto Cury.

item.title: VÍDEO: O que faz o senador? Entenda as funções do cargo
item.description: The video explains that senators are representatives of the Legislative Power, with duties such as creating laws, overseeing the Executive, analyzing the budget, and opening CPIs. They also participate in impeachment processes and scrutinize nominations to the STF and PGR. The g1's 50-video series guides viewers on the 2026 elections.

item.title: André Mendonça empurra Alexandre de Moraes para a fogueira e incendeia a eleição
item.description: PF disclosures about ties between Justice Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro plunged the STF into unprecedented crisis 33 days before the 2026 election. André Mendonça, rapporteur of the Master case, lifted secrecy prematurely, echoing Sergio Moro’s 2018 role and inflaming judicial and electoral tensions.

item.title: Fim da 6x1: CCJ do Senado pode votar nesta quarta proposta que reduz jornada de trabalho
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee may approve on Wednesday the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule, reducing the work week from 44 to 40 hours over up to 14 months, guaranteeing two rest days, preferably including Sunday. The proposal, reported by Senator Omar Aziz, maintains the rules approved by the Chamber and follows a transition timeline: 42 hours in two months and 40 hours in one year. Aziz notes the current schedule disproportionately affects low-income workers.

item.title: PF aponta oito encontros de Daniel Vorcaro com Alexandre de Moraes
item.description: The Brazilian Federal Police identified eight meetings between banker Daniel Vorcaro and Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes through messages obtained from a seized phone in the Master case. The meetings include events in Brazil and abroad, private residence gatherings, and interactions with political figures such as Hugo Motta and Ciro Nogueira. The report was made public after Minister André Mendonça lifted the seal on the document.

item.title: Após acordo entre governo e parlamentares, Congresso deve votar hoje MP do fim da 'taxa das blusinhas'
item.description: Following an agreement between the government and lawmakers, Congress is set to vote today on the provisional measure ending the 'blusinhas tax', exempting international purchases up to $50 from the 20% fee. The measure, shaped by political negotiations and resistance over postal exclusivity, advances as an electoral banner of Lula with allied support in the joint committee.

item.title: Moraes mudou configuração de mensagens temporárias 2 meses antes de prisão de Vorcaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes changed the temporary message settings in private chats with Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, two months before Vorcaro's first arrest in November 2025. The change was identified in a Federal Police report that analyzed Vorcaro's phone. The arrest occurred following a decision by the Federal Justice of Brasília.

item.title: CCJ do Senado pode votar nesta quarta a PEC da Segurança
item.description: The Public Security Constitutional Amendment Proposal (PEC), considered a priority by the federal government, may be voted on Wednesday in the Senate's CCJ. The proposal aims to strengthen the fight against organized crime and establish the Unified Security System in the Constitution. The rapporteur, Senator Rogério Carvalho (PT-SE), removed from the text the provision for allocating 30% of betting revenue to fund security funds, which will be addressed in a subsequent ordinary law.

item.title: Em meio a embate sobre escala 6x1 no Senado, Flávio deixa Brasília para agenda com agro e comício no RS
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) addresses the 6-1 Senate vote and leaves Brasília for a agenda with agribusiness and a rally in Rio Grande do Sul, urging Jair Bolsonaro’s supporters not to give up on Brazil.

item.title: Flávio critica Senado por omissão e pede impeachment de Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro called for the impeachment of Minister Alexandre de Moraes over messages exchanged with Daniel Vorcaro. He accused the Senate of omission and labeled the messages as obstruction of justice.

item.title: Lula chama de “traidores da pátria” quem quer entregar terras-raras
item.description: Lula denounces 'traitors of the nation' who support handing over rare earth reserves, reinforcing national sovereignty and domestic processing of strategic minerals in his reelection campaign.

item.title: Campanha de Lula quer usar diálogo entre Moraes e Vorcaro para pedir fim de sigilo no caso 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Lula allies leverage Moraes-Vorcaro dialogues to push for ending secrecy in the 'Dark Horse' case, which investigates ties between the banker and Flávio Bolsonaro. The move seeks to expose investigations into alleged irregularities in a real estate purchase in Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: O fator Augusto Cury
item.description: Doctor and writer Augusto Cury surprised by leading vote intention polls after a debate on Band, scoring 8% and 7.8% in BTG/Nexus and AtlasIntel/Bloomberg surveys. His popularity surged, gaining from 8.3 million to 10.5 million followers within a week.

item.title: Ao menos 1.481 candidatos alteraram lista de redes sociais informada ao TSE para campanha
item.description: At least 1,481 candidates in the 2026 elections changed their list of social media profiles reported to the TSE, while 2,719 did not register any internet address. Updating digital information is mandatory for transparency in the electoral campaign. The data was released on January 9, 2026.

item.title: Aliados de Lula veem risco à democracia caso Flávio possa nomear substituto de Moraes
item.description: Lula's allies warn that if Flávio Dino gains the chance to appoint a replacement for Alexandre de Moraes at the STF, there is a risk to the court's independence, as the elected president could appoint up to 5 of the 11 justices. The concern underscores debates on power concentration and institutional integrity.

item.title: Alcolumbre sinaliza que não deve avançar com impeachment de Moraes
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre stated he does not intend to move forward with impeachment requests against STF justices, particularly Alexandre de Moraes, awaiting internal developments within the Supreme Court. The opposition has intensified pressure with actions such as new criminal complaints and impeachment requests, but faces resistance in Senate leadership.

item.title: A decisão do TSE sobre vídeo de inteligência artificial com Jair Bolsonaro em ato de Flávio
item.description: The TSE rejected a fine against Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign for using an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro during his candidacy launch, ruling that the content was shared during a party convention and does not constitute irregular campaign activity. The court also defined deep fake as AI-produced content capable of altering the image and voice of real or fictional persons, applicable to ongoing electoral cases.

item.title: Grass diz que "não há ataque" de Lula ou do PT ao Fundo Constitucional
item.description: Leandro Grass, PT candidate for governor of the Federal District, denied any attack by President Lula or the PT against the Federal District Constitutional Fund, stating the previous government transferred 16 billion reais while the current one sent 28 billion. He addressed a bill signed by Lula that may affect the FCDF, with an estimated loss of 1.8 billion reais to the district in 2027.

item.title: Caiado anuncia Ratinho Júnior para Ministério da Infraestrutura em eventual vitória ao Planalto
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado announced Ratinho Júnior as Infrastructure Minister in case of presidential victory. The nomination follows an internal PSD dispute. Caiado leads with 5% of voting intentions.

item.title: Presidente do Conselho do Einstein, Claudio Lottenberg é afastado do cargo durante o período eleitoral
item.description: Claudio Luiz Lottenberg, chairman of the Einstein Israelite Hospital board, was temporarily removed from his governance duties during the election period after candidate Flávio Bolsonaro announced he would appoint him as Minister of Health. The suspension follows the institution's political neutrality code. Lottenberg said he spoke with the candidate and remains willing to contribute to the country.

item.title: Confira como foi a terça-feira (1º) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: On Tuesday (1st), presidential candidates carried out campaign activities, including visits to healthcare institutions, street campaigns, and public events. Ronaldo Caiado stood out with proposals for SUS reform and public spending limits, while other candidates like Augusto Cury and Hertz Dias also campaigned across various regions. Some candidates, such as Flávio Bolsonaro and Samara Martins, had no public agenda disclosed.

item.title: Senado aprova projeto do Redata, que incentiva data centers no Brasil
item.description: The Senate approved the Redata project, which provides tax incentives for companies to install or expand data centers in Brazil. The measure is a priority of President Lula's government and moves to presidential sanction. Participating companies will be exempt from taxes on equipment purchases, provided they allocate part of processing capacity to domestic services and use renewable energy.

item.title: Mascote do Atlético-MG chama a atenção antes de jogo pela Copa do Brasil
item.description: The Atlético-MG mascot, Galo Doido, hung from a rope at Arena MRV before the Clássico against Cruzeiro in the Copa do Brasil. The fans reacted with enthusiasm watching the mascot's acrobatic performance.

item.title: O dilema que deve atormentar Edson Fachin após mensagens de Vorcaro a Moraes
item.description: The disclosure of messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone puts the STF in an institutional crisis, requiring President Edson Fachin to take a stance on investigations involving figures such as Alexandre de Moraes, Paulo Gonet, and PF members. The case generates internal pressure and raises questions about institutions' ability to investigate authorities mentioned in the conversations.

item.title: Gonet entra na trama contra Mendonça, sem questionar a ‘gratidão de vida’ de Vorcaro a Moraes
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office, led by Paulo Gonet, entered the Master scandal narrative by condemning Minister André Mendonça while overlooking accusations against Alexandre de Moraes, deepening the crisis at the Supreme Court. The PGR faced criticism for not investigating ties between Moraes and former banker Daniel Vorcaro, despite being mentioned in messages seized by federal police. This stance fuels internal divisions within the STF and intensifies calls for impeachment against implicated justices.

item.title: Alcolumbre se esquiva de comentar mensagens de Vorcaro a Moraes: 'Não devo achar nada'
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre avoided commenting on messages between banker Daniel Vorcaro and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, stating he 'should not think anything' about the case. He also noted that there are 109 impeachment requests against Supreme Court justices pending in Congress, which he deemed abnormal, during a week of intense legislative voting.

item.title: Master: Pimenta defende que “todos os personagens devem ser investigados”
item.description: Federal deputy Paulo Pimenta (PT-RS) called for investigations into all individuals mentioned in the Banco Master allegations, including justices and politicians, regardless of the electoral context. He emphasized impartial probes to strengthen institutions and democracy.

item.title: Renan se diz ‘vitorioso’ após Toffoli voltar atrás e promete ‘mais energia’ na campanha
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli reversed the suspension of Renan Santos's campaign, who publicly declared himself victorious and vowed to intensify his campaign momentum. Renan harshly criticized STF ministers and political figures like Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, reinforcing his anti-establishment and resistance narrative.

item.title: Repasse de Vorcaro para filme sobre Bolsonaro em setembro de 2025 contradiz versão dada por Flávio, aponta revista
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro transferred $1.6 million in September 2025 to the fund financing the movie ‘Dark horse’, according to a report published by Piauí magazine. This contradicts Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s claim that the last payment took place in May of that year. The transfer occurred eight days after Flávio demanded the overdue installments, bringing the total amount sent to $12.3 million.

item.title: Kássio vota para definir critérios para deepfake e não vê ilícito em IA de Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE president Kássio Nunes Marques established three criteria to identify illicit deepfakes: synthetic content, high realism, and manipulation of image or voice. He did not consider the AI video of Bolsonaro at the PL convention illegal, stating the rules will apply going forward. The TSE does not ban AI use in electoral ads but requires labeling.

item.title: Cury propõe 8 anos de mandato para ministros do STF: "Reforma profunda"
item.description: Augusto Cury proposes limiting the term of STF ministers to eight years, advocating for a deep reform of the Court. During an event in Belo Horizonte, he criticized the long tenure of ministers and defended the renewal of public positions with fixed terms. His campaign launched its first Cury House in the city, which will serve as a campaign base and mobilization point.

item.title: TSE rejeita multa a Flávio por vídeo de Jair Bolsonaro por IA em convenção do PL
item.description: The TSE decided, by majority, not to fine Flávio Bolsonaro for using an AI-generated video featuring Jair Bolsonaro's image during the PL convention, ruling that the content was shown in an internal party event and did not constitute electoral campaigning. The decision was led by TSE president Kássio Nunes Marques, who emphasized that political support directed at convention members does not amount to a request for votes.

item.title: Lula promete tomar ‘decisão mais drástica’ contra bets
item.description: President Lula stated during a meeting that he intends to take drastic action against online betting platforms, viewing them as harmful to society. He noted that the government has tried regulating and banning betting sites, but illegal platforms make oversight difficult. Lula also criticized the impact of betting on football and household debt.

item.title: Senador que pediu impeachment de Moraes usa argumento do próprio ministro do STF no caso do golpe
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD-MG) filed an impeachment request against Minister Alexandre de Moraes, questioning the deletion of messages from an institutional phone at the Supreme Court. He referenced the 'Débora do Batom' case and called for an investigation into potential misuse of privileged information to benefit Daniel Vorcaro, should suspicions be confirmed.

item.title: Grassi promete correr 42 km em volta do TSE todos os dias em protesto à decisão de Toffoli
item.description: Presidential candidate Wilson Grassi announced he will run 42 km daily around the TSE to protest Minister Dias Toffoli’s ruling barring his digital campaigning, access to public funds, and debate participation due to late disclosure of social media profiles. Toffoli rejected Grassi’s delay in reporting eight campaign-related profiles, while reversing a similar measure against Renan Santos (Missão).

item.title: Senado aprova Redata com margem para uso de gás natural; texto vai à sanção
item.description: The Senate symbolically approved PL 278/2026, establishing Redata, a special regime for data centers allowing the use of natural gas as a complementary energy source. Reported by Cid Gomes, the bill heads to presidential sanction after adjustments avoiding return to the Chamber, including fiscal exemptions of R$1 billion annually and requirements for renewable energy and environmental transparency.

item.title: Citado por Flávio como possível ministro, Lottenberg deixa presidência do Conselho do Einstein
item.description: Cláudio Lottenberg, mentioned by Flávio Bolsonaro as a potential minister, stepped down from the presidency of the Albert Einstein Hospital Board during the election period. The hospital announced he is on leave from his governance duties until the end of the electoral period.

item.title: É fundamental que tenhamos afastamento mais rápido possível de Moraes do STF, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential candidate, called for Minister Alexandre de Moraes' removal from the STF following leaked conversations with banker Daniel Vorcaro. The request aims to pressure the federal judiciary amid recent controversies.

item.title: Relator diz que 6x1 passa no Senado nesta semana e critica PEC de Flávio
item.description: Senator Omar Aziz (PSD-AM), rapporteur of the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale, announced he will present his report tomorrow and seek same-day plenary voting in the Senate. He criticized the alternative PEC backed by Flávio Bolsonaro.
